name: Topbar Pulse
description:
System monitor, network details and AI usage in the top bar.

• CPU, GPU (Intel, AMD, NVIDIA), RAM, disk, network, sensors and the busiest processes
• Network: Wi-Fi details, public IP and location, VPN and DNS leak check, Wi-Fi band and DNS provider, speed test, share Wi-Fi by QR code
• USB: an icon that only appears while something is plugged in; console cables show their /dev path and open a serial console
• AI: quick launch for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Mistral, Perplexity and more — as an app window, a browser tab or the CLI in a terminal — and, if you turn it on, subscription limits for Claude Code, Codex (ChatGPT) and GitHub Copilot

The public IP check uses ipleak.net, the DNS check bash.ws and the speed test the public Tele2/Hetzner test servers. Subscription limits are off by default; when on, they use the sign-in the official CLIs keep on your computer and contact only that provider. Clipboard: clicking a serial port in the USB menu copies its /dev path to the clipboard; nothing is ever read from the clipboard. Tested on GNOME 51.
